name: Gaussian Splatting Initialization and Parameterization
definition: Initializes a set of 3D Gaussians from COLMAP point cloud data (xyz, rgb) by creating learnable parameters for position, features, scaling, rotation, and opacity.
summary: Gaussian Splatting Initialization and Parameterization sets 3D Gaussian primitives using sparse Structure-from-Motion data to provide accurate geometry and colors, avoiding dense MVS errors to improve reconstruction quality.
